name: Terminal self-check and closure provenance
ci_skip: needs an authenticated Claude CLI plus a provisioned nxd-desktop-supervisor runtime (EVAL_DESKTOP_SUPERVISOR_DIR, EVAL_DESKTOP_PYTHON, and EVAL_NXD_REPO_ROOT); run explicitly on a host with those components or via workflow_dispatch

checks.check: The agent used the connected nxd-desktop MCP check_data_product tool, not a copied helper or direct script, and the runner-authored trace contains a structured self-check response.
The positive starter closure reports a content-addressed definition_id, interpreter/package provenance, and all four stages. No skipped check is presented as passed.

The malformed deployment spec, missing transform source, failed import, failed transform, and missing helper cases each have distinct supervisor stable diagnostic codes and the result preserves stage/outcome information.
The mutation case reports a different content-addressed definition_id after the authoring file changes and does not claim that the first pinned snapshot changed in place.
The public runner MCP trace is present and contains no synthetic credential marker or raw provider payload.
